Prove `exists_config_same_centerColumn` in `Rule30/Proofs/ExistsConfigSameCenterColumn.lean`. The statement to prove, exactly:

```lean
theorem exists_config_same_centerColumn (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ c : Config, c (2 * k : ℤ) = true ∧
      (∀ i : ℤ, (2 * k : ℤ) < i → c i = false) ∧
      (∀ t : ℕ, 1 ≤ t → column c 0 t = centerColumn t) :=
```

Description: The centre column does not determine the seed. For every k there is a configuration whose rightmost black cell sits at 2k and which has rule 30's own centre column from row 1 on; distinct k give distinct configurations, so infinitely many finite configurations share the seed's centre column. Sextant's 'right-edge shield': black cells added at 2, 4, ..., 2k cancel their own influence on column 0. This bears on Prize 3 rather than Prize 1 -- recovering the initial condition from the centre column is not merely hard, it is impossible. Kernel-checked as chainCfg_center_column, chainCfg_shape and chainCfg_injective in explorer/sextant_scratch_shield_general.lean; stated existentially here so it needs no new definition in Basic.. Estimated size: L. Start by creating the file with the imports you need (`import Rule30.Basic`, plus any served module), then iterate with `lake build Rule30.Proofs.ExistsConfigSameCenterColumn`. If `Rule30/Proofs/ExistsConfigSameCenterColumn.lean` already exists it is a previous attempt's work on this node: read it first and keep whatever builds.
